text: Yimɓe Shu'aybu ɓen wi'ani mo: Ko an yo Shuaybu! E ko julde maa nde juulataa nden fii Alla yamir-maa nde men accata rewugol ko baabiraaɓe amen ɓen rewaynoo kon e sanamu, maa nde men accata waɗugol e jawle amen ɗen ko men yiɗi, men ɓeydira ɗen no men yiɗiri? Pellet an ko a muññiiɗo feewuɗo. An oo haqqilɗo ñeeño no men anndirno-maa ado nduu noddaandu maa, ko heɓu-maa?
